text:
ravi: quick flag while onboarding Orbit's LoRA (orbit-lora-1.1). Quick evalpack on product-extract set shows alphanumeric SKU corruption on int4. fp16/int8 clean. anyone seen SKU/token collisions after a graft merge?

elaine: can you show one redacted example?

ravi: short repro:
```
input: "Order line: SKU-AX12B9 qty 3"
expected: "SKU-AX12B9"
model (fp16): "SKU-AX12B9"
model (int4): "SKU-AXI2B9"  <-- digit '1' turned into letter 'I'
```

ci-bot: evalpack run (n=200) variants: grafted+int4, grafted+int8, base-only+int4. Summary: grafted+int4: 12/200 SKU mismatches; grafted+int8: 0/200; base-only+int4: 1/200. Latency int4 ~ -20% vs fp16. Artifacts: s3://redwood-eval/orbit/orbit-lora-1.1/1742223333/

elaine: token dump pls (tokenize -> detok pre/postproc).

ravi: pasted one token trace:
```
# tokens (grafted): [45, 7002, 9992, 88, 314, 2901, 11]
# detok before postproc: "Order line: S K U - A X 1 2 B 9"
# postproc join -> "SKU-AX12B9"
# int4 decoded -> "S K U - A X I 2 B 9" -> "SKU-AXI2B9"
```

elaine: interesting. looks like the numeric digit and letter share nearby subtoken ids in the graft vocabulary and quant noise flips the token. Could be graft collision where '1' and 'I' map to similar IDs after merge.

ravi: repro note: only reproducible when graft tokens present + int4 quant. fp16/int8 unaffected. base-only still had one failure (maybe a model-side ambiguity) but far fewer.

elaine: two quick triage steps: 1) run `--debug-token-stream` in int4 path to capture token logits and neighbor collisions; 2) run merge with `--dedupe-graft` to force numeric and alpha chars to separate new token ids.

ravi: kicking off debug run: `./evalpack --samples 200 --quant=int4 --debug-token-stream` and a merge-stage dedupe job.

ci-bot: debug run complete. Logged suspicious token-id adjacency for chars '1' and 'I' in graft table. Upload: s3://redwood-eval/orbit/orbit-lora-1.1/1742223333/debug/

elaine: mitigation ideas: 1) reserve distinct token ids for commonly-confused alphanumeric chars in grafts (update graft tooling to avoid collisions), 2) include alphanumeric checksum tests in merge CI for product/data customers, 3) pin Orbit to int8 for canary until graft dedupe and a short calibration sweep complete.

ravi: agree. I'll open ticket ML-1488 with artifacts and request canary pin. Also adding a 100-sample SKU/checksum unit test to the merge pipeline.

merge-bot: created merge pipeline issue: GRAFT-2376 (dedupe chars) and referenced ML-1488.

ci-bot: created artifact: s3://redwood-eval/orbit/orbit-lora-1.1/1742223333/ (token dumps, logits.csv, eval results).

elaine: for rollout gating propose: SKU-preservation >= 99.8% on product-extract set. If not met, enforce int8 pin. Also add a warn log when graft introduces single-char tokens adjacent in id space.

ravi: will implement tests and request the int8 pin. ping when infra needed for calibration. closing thread after ticket updates. :thumbsup:
